Set next value of the secret seed according to "counting" expression defined by a cryptographic
algorithm associated with this object.
Notes:
If the associated cryptographic algorithm doesn’t specify a "counting" expression then generic
increment operation must be implemented as default (little-endian notation, i.e. first byte is least
significant).
